titulo: Canadian bans on U.S. alcohol take centre stage in tariff talks. American businesses are caught in the middle
cuerpo: Bans by Canadian provinces on U.S. alcohol has taken centre stage in trade negotiations as premiers consider whether to put bottles back on the shelves to pacify the White House. Winemakers and industry associations say it's bewildering to have their livelihoods end up as leverage in an international dispute.
